name: Graveyard counts: cycling, names, graveyards of seven, permanent cards, card types (Vile Manifestation, Growth Cycle, Master's Councillors, Souls of the Lost, Nethergoyf)
notes: P1's seven cards: Barren Moor (cycling), Ash Barrens (typecycling), Growth Cycle, Invasion of Zendikar // Awakened Skyclave (a battle card, no creature card), Lightning Bolt, Divination, Sol Ring. Opponent's: Growth Cycle, Krosan Tusker, Grizzly Bears. Vile +2; one seven-card graveyard is +2/+0 for Master's Councillors; Souls counts four permanent cards (4/5); Nethergoyf five types: land, instant, battle, sorcery, artifact (5/6); Growth Cycle gives the Bear +3/+3 and +2/+2 for P1's one card of that name. Memory: project_graveyard_counts_by_owner_and_kind_2026-11-22.

scryfallData.name: Master's Councillors
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Vigilance
This creature gets +2/+0 for each graveyard with seven or more cards in it.
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, target player mills three cards. (They put the top three cards of their library into their graveyard.)

scryfallData.name: Souls of the Lost
scryfallData.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or sacrifice a permanent.
Fathomless descent — Souls of the Lost's power is equal to the number of permanent cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.

scryfallData.name: Nethergoyf
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Nethergoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
